parts.stem:
Fig. 2.2 is a transmission electron micrograph of a cross-section of an arteriole. Blood flows from muscular arteries through arterioles into capillary networks.

The lining of the arteriole is folded because the arteriole has constricted. This constriction causes the blood pressure to decrease from $12.7\text{ kPa}$ in the muscular artery to $2.7\text{ kPa}$ at the end of the arteriole.

{{figure:figure-2-2-full-v2.png}}
